Exercise 9. a) ⁧مَطَار بَغْدَاد⁩ maṭār Baġdād, Baghdad airport · ⁧نِظَام سِيَاسِيّ⁩ niẓām siyāsī, political system · ⁧غَيْر رَسْمِيّ⁩ ġayr rasmī, unofficial · ⁧عَدَد⁩ ʿadad, number. b) If a supplement describing the action comes later (for example, at the airport for ten years) it is the verb: ʿamila š-šurṭiyyu The cop worked... If the group acts as a subject or object of another sentence, it is the name: ʿamalu š-šurṭiyyi The work of the policeman is done. Without the rest of the sentence you can't decide: in a report it translates only after reading it all.
